title: Off-street parking

blocks.html: Accessory off-street parking spaces are not required in Zone C. However, a maximum of 300 public parking spaces are permitted in subzones C-1 and C-2 combined, provided that:
blocks.plainText: Accessory off-street parking spaces are not required in Zone C. However, a maximum of 300 public parking spaces are permitted in subzones C-1 and C-2 combined, provided that:

blocks.html: (a)        such spaces shall be completely enclosed;
blocks.plainText: (a) such spaces shall be completely enclosed;

blocks.html: (b)        no portion of the parking facility, other than entrances and exits, shall be visible from adjoining zoning lots, streets, parks or the Esplanade ;
blocks.plainText: (b) no portion of the parking facility, other than entrances and exits, shall be visible from adjoining zoning lots, streets, parks or the Esplanade ;

blocks.html: (c)        no exhaust vents shall open onto any street or park; and
blocks.plainText: (c) no exhaust vents shall open onto any street or park; and

blocks.html: (d)        the parking facility shall not be more than 23 feet above curb level.
blocks.plainText: (d) the parking facility shall not be more than 23 feet above curb level.
